$comment: Hard npm-tarball budgets against the fixed pre-8.0.0 baseline. Required public docs, editor/CEM data, declarations and runtime remain shipped; both byte ceilings retain the measured required-public-artifact exception and do not claim the mathematical 25% targets were met. The favorable incomplete-package probe still packed to 6,088,928 bytes, above its 5,872,345-byte target even before restoring declarations, CSS and other runtime artifacts. The integrated category-legend, native-button-state, table-sort and attribution changes measure 7,161,539 packed bytes and 29,561,077 unpacked bytes under Node 22.23.2/npm 10.9.8. Against the same-tool repack of published 14.2.0, required docs/editor/CEM/package metadata add 65,639 unpacked bytes, declarations add 12,441, and runtime/CSS add 10,382. All 3,164 public paths are retained. Byte ceilings equal those exact reviewed measurements plus the existing 34,000 packed and 140,000 unpacked headroom bytes, each below 0.5%. The file ceiling remains 2,500 base artifacts + 285 stable aliases times 2 + 94 measured non-alias remainder + 7 next-component files = 3,171. Fixed targets/baselines, exception reason, exact ceiling equality, the 0.5% headroom bound, and source/map/test/fixture/story rejection remain independently enforced.
